name: current-open
query: TABLE WITHOUT ID file.link AS Issue, board AS Board, last_updated AS "Last updated", length(Involved) AS People FROM "Town/Issues" WHERE status = "open" SORT last_updated DESC

name: group-status
query: TABLE WITHOUT ID status AS Status, length(rows) AS Count, rows.file.link AS Issues FROM "Town/Issues" WHERE status GROUP BY status SORT status ASC

name: flatten-involved
query: TABLE person FROM "Town/Issues" FLATTEN Involved AS person WHERE person SORT file.name

name: outgoing
query: LIST FROM outgoing([[2026-08-19 - Meeting]]) SORT file.path

name: tags
query: TABLE file.tags, file.etags FROM #civic SORT file.path

name: tasks
query: TABLE WITHOUT ID t.text AS Text, t.status AS S, t.line AS L, t.due AS Due FROM "Town" FLATTEN file.tasks AS t SORT t.line

name: lists
query: TABLE WITHOUT ID l.text AS Text, l.parent AS P, l.section AS Sec FROM "Town/Videos" FLATTEN file.lists AS l SORT l.line

name: inline-fields
query: TABLE priority, file.day FROM "Town" WHERE priority OR file.day SORT file.path

name: file-fields
query: TABLE WITHOUT ID file.name, file.folder, file.ext, length(file.outlinks) AS outs, length(file.inlinks) AS ins FROM "Town" SORT file.path
